reconstructionSuffix.description: An optional suffix that is added to the column names of the reconstruction {@link Data}.

title:
This Type represents a base reconstruction algorithm by defining a set of fields that all reconstruction algorithm
Types should contain. This Type is intended to be mixed-in by developers of concrete reconstruction algorithms.
name: Reconstruction.Algorithm.Fields
